hint.en: Verifies the Leapmotor server's identity using a pinned public key before any data is sent. The Leapmotor gateway uses a private certificate authority and does not send its intermediate certificate, so ordinary certificate-chain validation cannot succeed; key pinning is used instead. Leave this on. Turn it off only if Leapmotor rotates their server key and the app has not been updated yet, and be aware that doing so allows an attacker on your network to read your credentials.
Choose how distance and speed are shown. Range, odometer and speed will show km/km/h or mi/mph. Tire pressure always stays in bar. Reopen the Homey app after changing to refresh the unit label.

Your vehicle might report a more optimistic range than you can actually drive. When enabled, it lowers the range displayed in the Homey app. This might help you with more accurate planning. It does not change your actual range
The percentage subtracted from the range reported by the car. 0% shows the range exactly as the car reports it.

Right 193 (Toggle Charge) is not granted on every car. If the start/stop button does nothing, switch to the charge plan workaround. Stop charging then writes a charge plan that only allows charging on Sundays between 18:00 and 18:01 with a 1% limit, which makes the car stop. Start charging deletes that plan again.
